name: civic-skills-submit-a-skill
description: Writes a civic agent skill as a real directory — SKILL.md, scripts, references — and opens the pull request that adds it to the civic-skill-exchange registry under the author's own GitHub namespace. Reads the registry's published frontmatter contract and category vocabulary at run time rather than carrying a copy, and reports the registry's own check result back rather than asserting the skill passed.
